crossRefs.note: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.
When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.
Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
“His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own…
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…

translations.web: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.
translations.bsb: We were tossed so violently that the next day the men began to jettison the cargo.
translations.kjv: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;
translations.asv: And as we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw the the freight overboard;
